caption: The drawing depicts a stylized, paisley-like motif in the center, featuring a combination of green, dark blue, and yellowish-orange colors. The central paisley shape curves inward and has a scalloped green border with blue interior details, including petal and teardrop shapes. Inside the paisley are yellow-orange floral designs and leaf-like elements, set on a dark blue background. Surrounding the main shape are radial patterns resembling leaves or petals in yellow-orange with green and blue accent lines, and light dotted flourishes extending outward. Additionally, two small stylized flowers, each yellow-orange with a blue dot center, are placed diagonally opposite each other near the upper left and right corners of the drawing, with green dots trailing towards the main motif. The drawing is set on a beige or off-white background, and there is typed text at the bottom indicating information about the artwork.
title: Early Californian Skirt from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
